nations.name: Bridgeport Indian Colony
nations.lands: Near Bridgeport in Mono County, California

facts.text: In 2010 testimony to Congress, the Colony’s chairman said its tribal government organized under the Indian Reorganization Act in 1976.

source.title: Bridgeport Indian Colony Prepared Testimony, July 28, 2010, p. 55
source.publisher: Bridgeport Indian Colony testimony, published by the U.S. House Committee on Natural Resources

facts.text: The Colony’s 2010 congressional testimony recounts building a health clinic in the 1980s in a project coordinated by the Toiyabe Indian Health Project.

source.title: Bridgeport Indian Colony Prepared Testimony, July 28, 2010, p. 55
source.publisher: Bridgeport Indian Colony testimony, published by the U.S. House Committee on Natural Resources

facts.evidence: the Tribe was able to build a small health clinic

facts.text: A law approved on October 18, 1974 declared the United States’ interest in specified Mono County land held in trust for Bridgeport Indian Colony.
facts.evidence: in trust for the Bridgeport Indian Colony
